# Digital Underground

> Digital Underground sells digital products (apps, guides, AI tools; pay once) at https://digitalundergroundstore.com/store/ and runs a free Developer Marketplace where independent makers list their apps, AI tools, books and templates at https://digitalundergroundstore.com/community/. Listing is free; checkout and delivery stay on each maker's own site.

## For agents: quickest path

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth for reads): `https://digitalundergroundstore.com/mcp`
  Tools: `search_listings`, `get_listing`, `submit_listing` (needs creator API key), `get_my_listing_status`.
- OpenAPI spec: https://digitalundergroundstore.com/openapi.json

## Browse listings (public, no auth)

- All approved listings: `GET https://digitalundergroundstore.com/api/community/listings` → `{listings: [{id, name, makerName, category, priceLabel, pitchShort, tags, visitUrl, imageUrl, ...}]}`
- One listing with full description: `GET https://digitalundergroundstore.com/api/community/listing?id=cm_...`

```
curl https://digitalundergroundstore.com/api/community/listings
```

## Submit a listing (creator API key)

- Ask the human creator for an API key. They create one in the Creator dashboard (https://digitalundergroundstore.com/community/dashboard/ → API keys). Never guess or reuse keys.
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer duk_...`
- Create: `POST /api/v1/listings` with JSON {name, projectUrl, category (apps|ai-tools|games|books|templates|other), stage (concept|development|beta|released|discontinued, required), pitchShort (≤280), descriptionLong (≤4000), imageUrl (https) or imageData (data URL ≤750 KB), tags, priceLabel, videoUrl?, terms: true}

```
curl -X POST https://digitalundergroundstore.com/api/v1/listings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DU_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"My App","projectUrl":"https://example.com/my-app","category":"apps","stage":"beta",
       "pitchShort":"What it does and who it is for.","descriptionLong":"Features and how to get it.",
       "imageUrl":"https://example.com/cover.png","tags":["productivity"],"priceLabel":"$9","terms":true}'
```

- Stage: Concept, In development, Beta / testing, Released or Discontinued. Listings without a stage count as Released. Change it later with PATCH {"stage": "released"}.
- Status: `GET /api/v1/listings/{id}` (pending → approved/rejected). New listings go live once they pass automatic screening; flagged ones wait for owner approval.
- Update: `PATCH /api/v1/listings/{id}` with only the fields to change. Edits to an approved listing return 202 "pending owner approval": the approved version stays live until the owner approves the revision (see `pendingRevision`).
- Limits: 10 writes/hour and 50 writes/day per key. HTTP 429 includes Retry-After.
- Only submit real products the creator owns, with accurate claims. Listings are screened automatically: clean listings go live right away; flagged ones wait for a human review.

## Links

- Marketplace: https://digitalundergroundstore.com/community/
- Submit form (humans) and terms: https://digitalundergroundstore.com/community/submit/
- API docs: https://digitalundergroundstore.com/community/api/
- OpenAPI: https://digitalundergroundstore.com/openapi.json
- MCP server: https://digitalundergroundstore.com/mcp (manifest: https://digitalundergroundstore.com/server.json)
- Store: https://digitalundergroundstore.com/store/ (best value to start: Complete Freelance Suite CA$79 https://digitalundergroundstore.com/store/p/complete-freelance-suite/ ; Offer Desk CA$19 https://digitalundergroundstore.com/store/p/offer-desk/)
- Blog (guides for indie makers): https://digitalundergroundstore.com/blog/

## Books (Digital Underground store)

- Thrillers: https://digitalundergroundstore.com/store/thrillers/ (He Came Home Without Her, a domestic thriller, CA$4.99; Null Harbor, a near-future thriller, CA$4.99)
